<script>
// Force a real download of the notebooks (some browsers ignore the `download`
// attribute and display the JSON instead): fetch the file and save it from a blob.
document.querySelectorAll('a[download]').forEach(a => {
  a.addEventListener('click', async e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      const r = await fetch(a.href);
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status);
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(await r.blob());
      const b = document.createElement('a');
      b.href = url; b.download = a.getAttribute('download'); document.body.appendChild(b); b.click(); b.remove();
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
    } catch (err) {
      window.location.href = a.href;   // fallback
    }
  });
});
</script>
